leads.headline: TANKERS HIT NEAR HORMUZ
leads.dek: Bahrain says an Iranian attack set a civilian industrial site ablaze; two tankers struck leaving the Strait of Hormuz; Tehran shortens its Hormuz reopening plan to two days.

leads.headline: MISSILES FIRED AT RIYADH
leads.dek: Saudi-led coalition intercepts three Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh and strikes Yemen's Hodeidah port.

leads.headline: COP31 TALKS RUN INTO OVERTIME
leads.dek: Antalya climate summit deadlocked over fossil fuels and finance; a draft drops any mention of coal, oil and gas; EU: a good deal or no deal.

leads.headline: RUSSIAN SHIP ABLAZE IN THE BALTIC
leads.dek: Cargo ship Sparta II catches fire in the Gulf of Finland after a suspected drone strike; crew evacuated.

leads.headline: STRIKE ON KRYVYI RIH; NATO VOW
leads.dek: Russian strike kills two in Zelenskyy's home city, dozens hurt; Poland reports airspace incursions; NATO vows to defend "every inch" of Poland.

leads.headline: M6.8 QUAKE SHAKES PERU'S ANDES
leads.dek: Strong earthquake in the Junín highlands injures 15; no deaths reported.

leads.headline: POISON LIQUOR KILLS 11 IN MANIPUR
leads.dek: Toxic alcohol kills at least 11 in India's northeast; more than 180 in hospital.

leads.headline: FACTORY FIRE: DOZENS MISSING
leads.dek: Rescuers search for dozens missing after a factory blaze in Indonesia; at least three dead.

leads.headline: FRANCE MARCHES AGAIN
leads.dek: Fourth straight weekend of cost-of-living protests; masked demonstrators clash with police in Strasbourg.

leads.headline: MEXICO CAPTURES 'EL CHAPO ISIDRO'
leads.dek: Army seizes the FBI most-wanted cartel boss; his arrest sparks deadly clashes in Sinaloa.

leads.headline: A SECOND SHIP ORBITS MERCURY
leads.dek: ESA's BepiColombo loops into orbit around the sun's nearest planet — only the second spacecraft ever to do it.

leads.headline: INDIA'S RECORD 629 IN WELLINGTON
leads.dek: Pant's century powers India's highest-ever Test total in New Zealand, 629–6 with a lead of 261.
